# devin_knowledge_note (Resource)

Manages a knowledge note in the Devin platform. Knowledge notes store reusable context that Devin retrieves automatically during sessions when the trigger conditions match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage an organization-wide knowledge note
resource "devin_knowledge_note" "deployment_process" {
  name    = "Deployment Process"
  content = <<-EOT
    ## Deployment Steps
    1. Run `terraform plan` to preview changes
    2. Get approval from the #platform-eng channel
    3. Run `terraform apply` during the maintenance window
    4. Verify the deployment via the status dashboard
  EOT
  trigger = "When working on infrastructure deployment tasks"
  scope   = "organization"
}

# Manage a repo-scoped knowledge note
resource "devin_knowledge_note" "api_conventions" {
  name      = "API Conventions"
  content   = "All API endpoints must use snake_case for JSON fields and return pagination metadata."
  trigger   = "When adding or modifying API endpoints in the payments service"
  scope     = "repo"
  repo_name = "myorg/payments-service"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) The body content of the knowledge note in markdown format. This is the information Devin will retrieve during sessions.
- `name` (String) The display name of the knowledge note. Must be between 1 and 200 characters.
- `trigger` (String) A description of when this knowledge note should be retrieved. Defines the scope or conditions under which Devin will surface this note (e.g., "When working on the payments service").

### Optional

- `repo_name` (String) The repository to scope the note to, required when `scope` is `repo`. Format: `owner/repo` (e.g., `myorg/myrepo`).
- `scope` (String) The visibility scope of the knowledge note. Valid values are `organization` (visible to all org members), `user` (visible only to the creator), or `repo` (scoped to a specific repository). Defaults to `organization`.

### Read-Only

- `author` (String) The author of the knowledge note. Either `user` or `system`.
- `created_at` (String) The ISO 8601 timestamp when the knowledge note was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the knowledge note (e.g., `note-abc123`).
- `size` (Number) The size of the knowledge note content in characters.
- `updated_at` (String) The ISO 8601 timestamp when the knowledge note was last updated.
